source.prompt: A short one-shot musical sting for a fantasy role-playing game, about eight seconds long: the moment a monstrous boss is heard gnawing in the dark before it appears. A deep low drum hit with a soft gong, a dissonant low string cluster that swells and rises, a high tremolo violin note and a brief muted brass stab, then the sound rings out and stops. Ominous but not a jump scare, orchestral, high quality. Instrumental only: no vocals, no spoken words. Duration: 8 seconds.
